claims.assertion: Yazhi describes secret meetings as compartmentalized layers, from Bilderberg to nonhuman and Federation representatives; each level receives need-to-know information.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
claims.qualifiers: She says exact participants and locations are difficult to establish.

claims.assertion: She says Federation officials speak with Reptilians, High Greys, secret-society leaders, and some elected officials; direct cooperation with regressive groups is unclear.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
claims.qualifiers: She says interactions may be permissive rather than direct cooperation.

claims.assertion: Yazhi portrays the Vatican as the Cabal’s central node and says both popes communicate with Federation representatives.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
claims.qualifiers: She says the Vatican comprises multiple levels.
